scope: TerrainLab V6 formation march only; not World/Region/Site or combat

assessment.performance_targets: 7 of 11 Army CPU P95 targets not met; all 11 frame P95/P99 targets met
assessment.editor_import: PASS; full --import completion, not the timed-out 15-second startup attempt

command_shapes.visual: Same wrapper, -Mode visual; use run file/args. All PNG captures are GPU-backed; headless results are not visual proof.
command_shapes.no_user_args: Omit the -- delimiter and args when a test has no user arguments.

test_version_boundaries: Nine visual cases used 1f4b4020... before V_HANDOFF-only cleanup-boundary assertions were corrected. Their case branches and renderer were unchanged; actual test hashes are preserved per run. V_HANDOFF and V_CAPTAIN_SWAP used a083f56a...; no runtime change occurred.
The F01 historical 30Hz 20-second failure is retained. Three explicit --v6-budget runs use the already-declared route/setup/initial-structure budget; old deadline was not changed.

historical_boundary: Older failures and diagnostic counterexamples are indexed, not reclassified as current failures or passes. Earlier successes remain in original logs and historical acceptance notes.

G01.observations: Six actual movement captures plus final: full 10x10 body, captain inside, consistent ground interpolation, no long snake on flat ground.

G02.observations: 91 checked frames: two rear members RUN while front and captain hold; both switch to WALK; full rectangular collective movement resumes, no visual snap.

G08_BEND.observations: Actual narrow curved terrace retains a multi-file connected body; captain stays inside while same-direction subsets reshape locally. 31 rendered frame checks; 2217 physical commits, 20 captain edges, independent front/rear minima 48/41. Last capture explicitly marks the following local passage, not command completion.

D01.observations: All six actual milestones inspected. Captain middle passage, first 20 receiving while tail crosses, true full 100-person middle rally, collective subset resumed, actual final egress all cleared at 465.6 s (core/egress zero), and final 10x10 at 477.2 s after five stable seconds; captain inside at x95, front x99.

E01.observations: Fixed flat-mouth fixture shows captain crossing after 20 guards, front receiving while upstream body waits, RUN outside the opening, all 100 egress complete at 84 s, protected final compact footprint stable to 89.1 s.

E02.observations: Fixed 0-to-1 reciprocal ramp: captain follows 20 guards through actual mouth, downstream RUN and upstream waiting, then all 100 clear and compact protected footprint stable 5 s. HUD front-guard count before ramp excludes units on higher level, while independent passage order remains protected.

V_MOVE.observations: All 12 zoomed original-frame samples inspected, plus full initial, midmove and final. Unit 1 moves one cell down with smooth interpolation and no snapback; 97-frame independent ground/owner checks pass and final commit count is 1.

V_FOLLOWER_SWAP.observations: All twelve captured movement regions plus full final inspected: reciprocal follower swap runs continuously, both reach opposite cells, other members stay fixed. Normal sprite projection overlaps midway during swap; physical owners stay unique, 97-frame checks pass, 2 edge commits and no rewind.

V_PUSH.observations: All twelve watched-region samples plus full final inspected. Forward blocker vacates first, followed by each remaining member; captain stays fixed. Commit order 4,3,2,1 over 97 legal-frame checks, no reversal, final four moved exactly one cell.

V_HANDOFF.observations: All twelve sampled watched regions and final full frame inspected. Original blocker completes before clean activation at frame 18; unstarted old three members remain fixed until then. Latest FOLLOW subsequently starts real new work, with all pending transaction epochs current; full final view includes members below zoom-sheet boundary. 97-frame interpolation/ownership checks pass; this is handoff acceptance, not final destination completion.

V_CAPTAIN_SWAP.observations: All twelve watched-region samples and full final inspected. Captain and follower interpolate reciprocal paths, finish at exchanged cells, no rewind; 97-frame checks pass with two commits. Earlier 40-second capture timeout retained separately; this full capture exits 0.

handoff.performance_scope: One approximately 3-second actual-render-delta sample per activity, 60 warmup frames, production HUD, no fabricated FPS/GPU timings; not a long-duration benchmark.
handoff.timing_tradeoff: D01 458.9/472.3/458.9 input seconds plus stable 5s, under 503s V6 but over 180s V5; F01 30Hz 20.9s misses V5 20s.
